name: Texting
description: Compose text messages to a character. The recipient replies in texting mode — environmental context (surroundings, others present, scene effects, items, wardrobe overrides) is stripped from their prompt so they don't 'see' the room. Useful for off-scene check-ins, SMS interludes, and any beat where the character isn't physically with the user. Per-block strip settings let you tune what falls away.

settings.label: Strip Surroundings
settings.help: Drop the [Surroundings] block from the responder's prompt when they're replying to a text.

settings.label: Strip Others present
settings.help: Drop the [Others present] block — text recipients don't see who else is in the user's room.

settings.label: Strip Items in scene
settings.help: Drop the [Items in scene] block. Off if you want the recipient to react to objects the user mentions.

settings.label: Strip Scene effects
settings.help: Drop scene-effect rules. Off if the magic / scene rules apply to texts too (rare).

settings.label: Strip Wardrobe overrides
settings.help: Drop the [Wardrobe overrides] block — text recipients don't need the slot directives that the on-screen render uses.

settings.label: Bubble style
settings.help: How texting turns render in chat. 'sms_bubble' = right/left-aligned chat bubbles; 'tinted' = muted background tint on the message body; 'inline_badge' = small SMS icon next to the speaker name.

gui_controls.label: Text
gui_controls.title: Send the next message as a text to a specific character — environmental prompt blocks are stripped from their reply.
